title: Muharram: the month of Allah
hook: the best fasting after Ramadan is in Muharram (Muslim)

segments.voice: Yesterday, the sacred months: Dhul Qa'dah, Dhul Hijjah, Muharram, and Rajab on its own. Your line: four sacred months. Did you find where the calendar stands right now? Today, one of the four, up close. Day one thousand three hundred fifty-four.

After Ramadan, which fast is best? In Sahih Muslim, that question is put to the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, and Abu Hurayrah reports his answer. It doesn't name a single day. It names a whole month, and gives that month a title you won't find printed on a calendar page. Not the month of the new year. Not the month of fasting. The month of Allah. Today: Muharram, and why it carries that name.
screen: `AFTER RAMADAN, WHICH FAST?` → `A WHOLE MONTH.` → `THE MONTH OF ALLAH.`

segments.voice: Here is the hadith, in paraphrase: the best fasting after Ramadan is in Allah's month, al-Muharram, and the best prayer after the obligatory prayers is the prayer at night. Look first at the pairing. One sentence, two offerings: an empty stomach by day, and a person standing awake at night. The hadith puts them side by side, as if the month had a daytime practice and a nighttime one. Second, the name. Every month belongs to Allah, Muslims say. So why call this one Allah's month? Some scholars explain it the way they explain the phrase house of Allah for a mosque. Every place is His, but naming one place after Him lifts it, sets it apart. Muharram gets its name attached to God's name, and the month is honored by it. And remember from yesterday: Muharram is already one of the four sacred months, the third of the three that come in a row. Third, and this is easy to miss: none of this is required. Ramadan's fast is a duty. Muharram's is an offer. The word in the hadith is best, not must. Nobody is told to fast the whole month. A person can take one day, or a few, and they're stepping into what the hadith praises. That makes Muharram a kind of open door at the start of the Islamic year, as tradition counts it. Fourth, it gives the fast a life outside Ramadan. A practice that only happens once a year can start to feel like a costume. A voluntary day in Muharram says the fast belongs to ordinary time, too.
screen: `A FAST BY DAY, A PRAYER BY NIGHT.` · `WHY CALL IT ALLAH'S MONTH?` · `AN OFFER, NOT A DUTY.` · `THE FAST IN ORDINARY TIME.`

segments.voice: The practice: choose one day. Settle, and breathe. If you fast, you might pick one day this Muharram, or the next time it comes, and see it on the calendar in your mind. If you don't fast, choose something else small to hold back from for one day: a snack, a scroll, a second coffee. Either way, notice what it's like to choose an offering nobody requires of you. Sit with the choice for the rest of the bell. If you pray, you can remember the night prayer the same hadith praises. The bell holds the time.
Muharram. A sacred month, called Allah's month in Sahih Muslim, where voluntary fasting is praised as the best after Ramadan. Today's word.

Your line: allah's month. Today, put the day you chose somewhere you'll see it, a calendar or a note, so the offer doesn't slip away. Tomorrow, Ashura: two ways. Day one thousand three hundred fifty-four.

howItsDone: Some Muslims keep voluntary fasts during Muharram, following a hadith in Sahih Muslim that calls it Allah's month and praises fasting in it as the best after Ramadan; the fast is voluntary, not required.

pairs: the best prayer after the obligatory

myth: fasting in Muharram is required, like Ramadan
the hadith calls it the best fasting after Ramadan: praised, not required.
the same hadith also praises the prayer at night
the best prayer after the obligatory ones is the prayer at night.
Muharram is one of the four sacred months
it's the third of the three that come in a row.

fork.setup: someone asks you which fast is best after Ramadan, according to the hadith in Sahih Muslim. what do you say?
fork.reveal: the hadith names a whole month, Muharram, and calls it Allah's month.

original.note: Arabic: Allah's month, al-Muharram, as the hadith calls it.

trapdoor: what you thought: Muharram is just the month on the calendar after Dhul Hijjah.
what it means: a sacred month, called Allah's month, where voluntary fasting is praised as the best after Ramadan.
what a scholar hears: the hadith in Sahih Muslim pairing Muharram's fast with the night prayer, and the possessive "of Allah" as a mark of honor.

sources.ref: Sahih Muslim 1163 (Abu Hurayrah: the best fasting after Ramadan is in Allah's month al-Muharram; the best prayer after the obligatory is the night prayer)
Sahih al-Bukhari 4662 (Muharram among the sacred months)

notes: Confirm Sahih Muslim 1163 numbering and paraphrase.
The explanation of 'Allah's month' as a possessive of honor (compared with 'house of Allah') is attributed to 'some scholars'; confirm.
'At the start of the Islamic year, as tradition counts it': confirm this framing is acceptable.

Editor pass: hook no longer claims 'everyone knows' Ramadan's fast or that people have asked 'for a long time', and no longer tells the listener what they'd expect; the question is now the one put to the Prophet in the Muslim 1163 report.
